export_rights.summary: Global admins (and regular users granted export permission) can export account data per data type from the UI and via the public API. The DPA states that return/deletion of personal data on termination is achieved via the client initiating export through the UI or Pipedrive support; Pipedrive's EU Data Act page additionally grants clients the right to export their exportable data to switch providers or to on-premises infrastructure.
export_rights.post_termination_window: No explicit retrieval window documented; ToS states the account and all Client Data are permanently deleted within 180 days of termination (within 1 month if the client requests earlier deletion), so export must be self-initiated before deletion

routes.how: Account menu (top right) > Tools and apps > Export data; select data type, choose Excel or CSV, click Export; file appears under Generated exports (download via cloud icon in the Available until column). Alternatively, from any list view use '...' > Export filter results to export the displayed fields, or open a single deal and use '...' > Export as XLSX.
requires: global admin (Export data tab); regular users need export permission enabled and only see data visible to them
gotchas: No single whole-account export button — each data type is exported separately
Activities, notes and files linked to deals/contacts must be exported separately; files and emails are not embedded in entity exports
Generated export files expire: available for download for 28 days
Exports are scoped by the exporting user's visibility groups/item visibility

routes.how: Public REST API v1/v2 at api.pipedrive.com; auth via personal api_token (sent as x-api-token header; grants the owning user's permissions, never expires unless regenerated) or OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow with Bearer access tokens (~1h expiry, refresh tokens). Paginate list endpoints (offset or cursor); v2 endpoints are cheaper in rate-limit tokens.
requires: api_token of an appropriately permissioned user, or an OAuth app grant
routes.rate_limits: Token-based daily budget shared account-wide: 30,000 base tokens x plan multiplier x number of seats; each endpoint has a token cost (v2 endpoints cost up to half of v1). Separate burst rate limits also apply. Max page size 500 items (100 default; files endpoint max 100 per page).
gotchas: Daily token budget is shared by all users and integrations on the account — large extractions can starve other integrations
api_token is per-user and inherits that user's visibility restrictions

routes.how: API: GET /v1/files to enumerate all file records (paginated, max 100 per page), then download each file individually via the file-download endpoint / the download URL returned in file metadata (standard HTTP GET with auth). No documented bulk file download in the admin UI.
requires: api_token or OAuth token with access to the files
routes.rate_limits: Counts against the shared daily API token budget; 100 items per page max on the files listing
gotchas: One HTTP request per file — large file stores mean many requests against the rate-limit budget
Entity exports (Export data tab) do not include the files themselves

routes.how: Insights: open a report or goal, scroll to the table view and export as XLSX/CSV; open a report and click Export for the current chart view (PDF/PNG); open a dashboard and use '...' > PDF export or PNG export (includes all visible reports in on-screen order).
requires: access to the Insights reports/dashboards being exported
gotchas: Chart/dashboard exports are images/PDF snapshots, not restorable report definitions

routes.how: Security dashboard > Audit log: filter by user, security event type and time frame, then use the '...' button to export the filtered results to a spreadsheet.
requires: admin access to the security dashboard
top-tier (Ultimate) plan for audit log, active devices and device history features
gotchas: Documented retention is only the past two months of security-related changes — export early and repeatedly during a teardown
Log covers security-related changes, not a full record-level change history

routes.how: No UI export of configuration is documented. Via the REST API, read the definition objects as JSON: DealFields (and the equivalent person/organization field endpoints), Pipelines, Stages and Filters reference endpoints documented at developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1.
routes.rate_limits: Shares the account-wide daily API token budget
gotchas: JSON definitions are documentation/rebuild artifacts, not importable restore packages
No documented export for Workflow Automations or Insights report definitions

preservation_notes.attachments: Not included in entity exports and no documented bulk download in the UI; enumerate via API GET /v1/files (max 100/page) and download each file individually via its download endpoint/URL
preservation_notes.audit_log: Security dashboard audit log (Ultimate plan) holds the past two months of security-related changes; filtered results export to a spreadsheet via the '...' button — retention beyond two months is not documented
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: No documented UI export of customizations; custom field definitions, pipelines, stages and filters are readable as JSON via the API reference endpoints. Export of Workflow Automations and Insights report definitions is not documented

notes: All claims come from search-engine summaries of the cited vendor pages rather than full-page reads — treat details (exact nav labels, the 28-day export availability, two-month audit retention, Ultimate-plan gating, 30,000-token rate formula) as needing in-tenant confirmation. Honest unknowns: no whole-account/backup export exists per docs; email message bulk export is not documented (community threads ask for workarounds); Workflow Automations and Insights report definitions have no documented export; plan multipliers in the API token-budget formula were not captured; exact spreadsheet format of the audit-log export is not specified in the summaries consulted. The 180-day figure in export_rights is a deletion deadline from the ToS, not a guaranteed retrieval window.
research_caveats: Direct fetches of pipedrive.com, support.pipedrive.com and developers.pipedrive.com were blocked by the research environment's egress proxy, so all claims come from search-engine summaries of the cited vendor pages rather than full-page reads.
